observations: SceneHierarchicalClustering.select_frame checks co-visibility, sorts by number of detected objects then cluster-object confidence sum, and prefers already-selected eligible frames before choosing the highest-ranked new frame.
Scene.update_snapshots reclusters the affected old snapshot clusters together with updated/new object IDs and asserts coverage/disjointness.
Prefiltering keeps snapshots whose assigned object categories intersect selected top-K categories; K counts categories, not snapshots.
A-EQA default config selects aeqa_questions-41.json, not the 184-question main-paper subset.
GOAT evaluation selects one episode per scene via split; current max-step budget is max(int(sqrt(scene_size)*ratio),50), differing from the supplementary text maximum-50 description.
GOAT logger separately reports success_by_snapshot and success_by_distance; the published paper describes distance-threshold success. Reproduction must select the matching metric.

evidence_summary.claim: Snapshot formulation, unique object ownership, co-visibility clustering and local incremental update
Prefiltering is top-K category selection, followed by snapshot inclusion on category intersection
A-EQA 184-question subset; shared-framework CG object-crop comparison; 52.6/42.0 vs 47.2/33.3
EM-EQA 57.2 with 3.1 frames vs 48.1 with 3.0 frames, both image methods use GPT-4o
GOAT subset has 36 scenes and 278 subtasks; memory 69.1/48.9 vs clearing 58.6/38.5
Full-set results differ from subsets; supplementary Table 7 nearest-frontier ablation
Static environment assumption; precise pose needed; moving objects not robust; global navmesh shortest path; planar frontier limitations

known_boundaries: The reported lifelong setting is same-scene sequential navigation; dynamic object identity/state histories were not evaluated.
Algorithm 1 is a compact-cover heuristic; no global-minimum snapshot-count guarantee was found.
Selected snapshot counts are prompt/memory-representation efficiency evidence, not a bound on all retained runtime state.
A-EQA mixes reproduced subset results and inherited full-set baseline scores; full-set supplementary evaluation only reports 3D-Mem.
Global navmesh planning and different baseline navigation stacks prevent treating all GOAT numbers as a controlled memory-only comparison.
Prefiltering removal was not evaluated because all-input prompts exceeded context; LLaVA-7B was additionally fine-tuned.
No user hypotheses or suggested future extensions are recorded as paper facts.
